description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the proprietary 4-step workflow and strict output format. (2) Parse raw JSON parameter files (raw_data/scraped/tesla/model3_params.json and raw_data/scraped/xiaomi/su7_params.json) and review text files to extract actual data values. (3) Apply Step 3.1's five mandatory parameter table layers: 基础信息层, 动力/续航层, 内饰/舒适层, 智驾层, 安全/空间. (4) Apply Step 3.2's exact review section format with 好评高频词, 投诉集中点, 代表性车主评论 sub-fields plus the footer containing 数据来源/采集时间/注：评论为用户主观表达. (5) Apply Step 4.1's exact 5-section output structure: 一句话总结 → 参数对比表 → 各维度胜出分析 (with '胜出' declarations) → 车主真实反馈 → 购买建议 (using '如果你更在意...选...' pattern) → final footer '数据采集时间 | 价格以官网最新为准'. An agent relying on generic training will produce a generic comparison but will miss the proprietary section names, the exact review sub-field names (好评高频词/投诉集中点/代表性车主评论), the mandatory '注：评论为用户主观表达' disclaimer wording, the '如果你更在意' purchase advice pattern, and the five-layer parameter table structure.
